title: UrduLM: A Resource-Efficient Monolingual Urdu Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing tokenization fertility (tokens per word) and downstream task performance (Sentiment Classification, Grammar Correction, QA) of the monolingual Urdu model against English-centric multilingual models (LLaMA, Qwen, Gemma) to quantify the performance gap and inefficiency caused by linguistic underrepresentation.
Qualitative manual inspection of model generations to assess the presence of culturally appropriate idioms, references, and linguistic nuances compared to multilingual models.
